source_text: After inhalation | No special measures necessary.
After contact with skin | Cool skin rapidly with cold water after contact with molten material. Do not peel solidified product off the skin. Get medical attention.
note: 줄 단위로 3문장으로 나눔

source_text: After contact with eyes | Obtain medical attention. In case of contact, immediately flush eyes with plenty of water for at least 15 minutes.
note: 2문장으로 나누고 'at least 15 minutes'를 cond 하한 15(>=) min으로 분리

source_text: After ingestion | Do NOT induce vomiting. Call in a physician immediately and show him the Safety Data Sheet.
note: 줄 단위로 2문장으로 나눔

source_text: Specific hazards arising from the chemical | In case of fire hazardous decomposition products may be produced such as: | Styrene | Hydrogen cyanide (hydrocyanic acid) | Acrylonitrile | Carbon monoxide | Carbon dioxide (CO2)

source_text: Environmental precautions | Do not allow to enter drains or waterways
Methods and materials for containment and cleaning up | Treat recovered material as described in the section "Disposal considerations".
